title: Billing Standard for Payment Arrangements: Down Payment and Installment Terms of an Offer
content:
**Billing standard — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): the terms stated on an offer**

**Down payment.** The down payment is the tier's down payment percent of the past-due amount, rounded to the cent, but not less than the tier's smallest down payment and never more than the past-due amount.

**Installment count and amount.** On a monthly schedule the member chooses the number of installments up to the tier's most installments; the count is reduced until each installment is at least the tier's smallest installment, and each installment is the arranged amount divided by the count, rounded to the cent, the last absorbing the difference.

**Harvest schedule.** On a single harvest installment schedule there is one installment, billed in the billing period of the tier's harvest installment month following the offer.

**First installment, fee and interest.** The first installment is billed the tier's stated number of billing periods after acceptance. The tier's arrangement fee, where above zero, is billed as a service fee with the first installment, and no interest is charged.

**Retired clauses.** The two clauses below are no longer in force; each is superseded by the current basis for the arranged amount recorded on acceptance, and neither may be applied:

> ~~The arranged amount is the past-due amount less the down payment (the pledged part included), and, current charges not being includable, charges not yet past due are never arranged.~~ — no longer in force.

> ~~Where the tier counts pledges toward the down payment, the open pledges reduce the down payment the member must pay, never below zero.~~ — no longer in force.

**Worked figures (hypothetical tier: 25 percent, smallest down payment $50.00, at most 3 installments, smallest installment $25.00)**

| Past-due amount | Percent of past due | Down payment |
|---|---|---|
| $180.00 | $45.00 | $50.00 (raised to the smallest down payment) |
| $40.00 | $10.00 | $40.00 (the smallest down payment would exceed the past-due amount) |
| $600.00 | $150.00 | $150.00 |

| Hypothetical arranged amount | Count chosen | Count used | Installments |
|---|---|---|---|
| $130.00 | 3 | 3 ($43.33 is at least $25.00) | $43.33, $43.33, $43.34 |
| $60.00 | 3 | 2 ($20.00 is below $25.00; at 2, $30.00) | $30.00, $30.00 |

superseded_clauses: The arranged amount is the past-due amount less the down payment (the pledged part included), and include_current_charges being false, charges not yet past due are never arranged.
where pledge_counts_toward_down_payment is true, the open pledges (arrange_msr_open_pledges) reduce the down payment the member must pay, never below zero.
